name: remotedeck
description: A local OpenSSH workspace with a Rust service and a simple browser UI

scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @remotedeck/web build && node scripts/verify-boundary.mjs && cargo test -p remotedeck-server
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @remotedeck/web build && pnpm test:integration && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace --all-features && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A linker-messages && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
